title: Annotatio VI §.VII: presence common to unfaithful and faithful vs faithful-only?
pass_a_gloss: Or will the Author judge that presence of Christ and of his body and blood common alike to unfaithful and faithful more real and truer than that proper to the Faithful alone? Nay, so professing, he will scarcely have tasted and even now perceived how acceptable the Lord is to those who cling to him by living faith!
pass_b_english: Or is a presence shared by unfaithful and faithful alike more real than the presence proper to the faithful alone?
Anyone who says so has barely tasted how welcome the Lord is to those who cling by living faith.
source_text: Aut realioremne veriorémque præsentiam istam Christi ejusque corporis & sanguinis arbitrabitur A., infidelibus fidelibúsque juxta communem, quam Fidelibus solis propriam? Næ, sic profitebitur, vix se gustasse & adhuc dum percepisse, quam acceptus Dominus iis sit, qui fide vivâ illi adhærent!
